run_mnist_training: run the MNIST training loop with configurable batch size, learning rate, and max epochs via argparse
test_ConvNetAgent: test the ConvNetAgent model on a test dataset and return loss and accuracy metrics
create_ConvNetAgent: create a ConvNetAgent with a 2-layer CNN, dropout, and linear head for 10-class MNIST classification
build_DataLoaderAgent: build a DataLoaderAgent or ShuffledDatasetAgent to feed MNIST batches into a Salina workspace pipeline
review_test_function: review the test function that evaluates a model agent against a dataloader agent and returns loss and accuracy
